description: The image, titled "Diagram 27 Ways of providing hearths", shows three stacked sectional views, labelled (a), (b) and (c), each depicting an "Appliance" (a rectangle) on a hearth or non-combustible board, with a hatched wall on the right in (b) and (c). In (a), captioned "Appliance that cannot cause hearth temperature to exceed 100°C", the appliance rests on a "Non-combustible board or tile" above "Combustible material"; arrows read "Clearances from Diagram 26", and a vertical dimension on the right reads "At least 12mm" under "Change in level to mark safe perimeter". In (b), captioned "Any appliance standing directly on a constructional hearth", the appliance sits on a shaded "Constructional hearth" beside "e.g. flooring" and "Combustible material"; "Clearances from Diagram 26" and "Change in level to mark safe perimeter" are shown, with a base dimension "Dimensions from Diagram 24". In (c), captioned "Any appliance in a fireplace recess with a superimposed hearth", a "Superimposed hearth" slab lies over a "Constructional hearth"; dimensions read "At least 150mm" and "At most 25mm", plus "Dimensions from Diagram 24", "Clearances from Diagram 26", "Change in level to mark safe perimeter", "Combustible material" and "e.g. flooring".
